elements.element: Placement of the net quantity statement

elements.quote: This shall be expressed in the terms of weight, measure, numerical count, or a combination or numerical count and weight, measure, or size.

elements.element: Prominence of the net quantity statement
elements.quote: The declaration shall appear in conspicuous and easily legible boldface print or type in distinct contrast
elements.note: 201.62(h) sets minimum type sizes by principal display panel area.

rationale: 201.62 states placement (d)/(e), units (a)/(b)/(i)/(j) and prominence (g)/(h) of the net quantity declaration. Scope note: 201.62(a) addresses the label of an over-the-counter drug in package form, while the question says 'a drug label' generally.
uncertainty: 201.62(a) is expressly limited to OTC drugs in package form; the question does not say OTC. An SME may want the question narrowed to OTC drugs.
